title: The Hunter's Sortie ('Three wolves: the charcoal ring... the leaning stones and clawed trunks north of it') never marks done even after its apparent resolution: I killed the aggressive lean wolf at the charcoal ring and showed the hunter its pelt ('That's the one that jumped anyone who came near the old fire ring... Wood's quieter for it' - reward given), and peacefully avoided the other two via the game's own '(free)' leave-be option per Lys's advice. The quest stayed listed, unresolved, in every status check through turn 628.
where: Hunter's Camp (west of Last Light) / quest log
